storyboard.title: Inflation Explained with Chocolate
storyboard.story: Opening: a striking portrait cover promises a visual explanation of inflation using chocolate. Transition: the illustration becomes a dimensional chart with two equally high bars. Payoff: in three seconds, the chocolate tablet shrinks to half its height while the gold ingot grows by one quarter. Hold a readable final contrast: less chocolate, more money. The bars are an illustrative metaphor for paying more and getting less, not historical data or an investment claim.
storyboard.message: Less chocolate. More money. A fast visual metaphor for inflation and shrinkflation, without a lecture.
storyboard.audience: English-speaking Shorts / TikTok viewers interested in quick, striking explanations; accessible to beginners, not financial advice.
storyboard.style: Portrait 9:16. Premium playful 2D/3D mix. Dark glossy tiled floor, black chart backdrop with white scale marks, warm dimensional lettering, tactile chocolate and polished gold. Fast, fluid motion. No percentages, dates, captions or narration; only the main title.

characters.name: Chocolate tablet
characters.description: Recurring visual subject, not a person: segmented brown chocolate bar, left side of the chart. Keep width and base fixed. Start at equal height to gold, shrink vertically to 50% of initial height.

characters.name: Gold ingot / money
characters.description: Recurring visual subject: polished warm-gold rectangular ingot, right side. Keep width and base fixed. Start level with chocolate, grow vertically to 125% of initial height. Represents more money needed, not rising gold prices.

settings.name: Dark dimensional chart stage
settings.description: A single consistent portrait stage: dark glossy tiles, a dimensional plinth, black slightly glossy chart backdrop, white scale lines visible above the floor. Main title above chart. Camera perspective and lighting should match the cover as closely as practical.

shots.title: Visual hook
shots.action: Show the illustrated cover and the title “Inflation Explained with Chocolate”. No extra explanatory text. Establish the chocolate/gold visual contrast.
shots.camera: Static portrait composition; strong readable title and chart.
shots.audio: No speech. Brief anticipation before the whoosh.

shots.title: Illustration becomes a chart
shots.action: Morph from cover into the 3D stage. Reveal chocolate and gold bars at exactly equal starting height. Keep their positions and the title aligned across the transition.
shots.camera: Match the cover angle; no abrupt jump or distracting camera spin.
shots.audio: Whoosh begins immediately after the transition.

shots.title: Less chocolate, more money
shots.action: In one fast, smooth move the left chocolate bar shrinks down to half height and the right gold ingot rises to one and a quarter height. Both stay grounded. End with a clear readable contrast; no percentage labels.
shots.camera: Nearly fixed front three-quarter view with a subtle cinematic drift; both bars and the headline always in frame.
shots.audio: One energetic rising/falling broadband whoosh, fading out at the end. No voice or music.

title: Inflation Explained with Chocolate
description:
Chocolate down. Money up. A three-second visual rush.

An illustrative material-area chart, not historical inflation data. The chocolate area represents getting less; the gold money area represents paying more. Inflation and shrinkflation simplified into one visual metaphor.

#Inflation #Shrinkflation #Shorts
firstComment: An illustrative visual metaphor, not historical price data.
